title: Floor Area Regulations on Waterfront Blocks
previewText: On waterfront blocks, the provisions of Section 62-31 (Bulk Computations on Waterfront Zoning Lots) shall be modified so that lot area that is seaward of the shoreline shall not be included for the purpose of determining allowable floor area or to satisfy any other bulk regulation.
